parameters.content:
Gallery publication (one brand)

Set ILL_ERP_BASE_URL and ILL_WEBFLOW_BRAND. Bind ERP credentials for an ilL Integration System User and Webflow credentials for that exact brand to every HTTP node. Deploy one workflow per brand. No secrets in variables or exports. The Galleries collection needs a plain-text erp-sync-id field first.

Started by ERP, not a timer: ERP calls the Gallery Webhook when a job is requested or a retry falls due (retries are 1, 5 and 15 minutes out). Bind a Header Auth credential to the webhook and set n8n_gallery_webhook_url (and the secret header) in the ERP site config. It claims one job at a time and drains at most 1000 jobs per run. Remote items are looked up by exact slug, so the size of the collection does not matter; a match must carry this erp-sync-id (or be a known imported item), and two candidates stop as identity-conflict. If Webflow ignored the slug filter on a collection over 100 items the job stops as lookup-incomplete. Failed calls record a safe error code only. Import inactive and test on staging2 before activation.

STAGE saves a draft; PUBLISH publishes the staged item; RETIRE unpublishes then archives and never deletes. No site-wide publish. Primary locale only.
